entries.profile_scope: 1.8B Q4_K_M v5 scene; 7B same-request negative control
entries.expected_invariant: A target cue naming Elsevier and its talented people must not be replaced by the following cue's business-content claim.
entries.last_outcome: The 1.8B accepted cue 861 omits Elsevier and repeats next-cue content; 7B retains the name. Human adequacy unscored.

entries.expected_invariant: A four-or-more-digit USD amount in a Russian sentence must be reviewed for grouping ambiguity before publication.
entries.last_outcome: Both model outputs keep 10,702 with a comma in Russian. This is a surface reading risk pending human judgment.

entries.profile_scope: 12-cue Paywall paired development screen and future SRT experiment preflights
entries.expected_invariant: A chat-call budget counts SRT text slots, including every line of a multiline cue, before a model run.
entries.last_outcome: The frozen plan described 12 calls plus four retries, but 12 cues contained 16 text slots; both runs used 16 calls with no retries. Future preflight counts slots.
